context: The pegs are A, B, and C from left to right. Each move transfers one top disk, and a larger disk cannot sit on a smaller one. Moving a single disk, f(1), is the base case of the recursion.
description: A green rounded rectangle represents the only disk. The two frames show the states before and after a single move.

frames.announcement: The initial state shows a single disk on peg A.
frames.explanation: Initially A=[green disk], B=[], and C=[]. No move has been made. Nothing covers the disk and destination C is empty, so it can move directly from A to C without using auxiliary peg B.
frames.key_state: A holds one disk. B and C are empty. No move has been made.
frames.title: The only disk is on peg A

frames.announcement: Move the only disk directly from peg A to peg C.
frames.explanation: The only green disk is exposed on top of A, and C is empty. Move the disk directly from A to C without using B. Now A=[], B=[], and C=[green disk]. This one move completes the task.
frames.key_state: One move is complete. The disk is on C, and A and B are empty.
frames.title: Move the disk directly from A to C

summary: Move the only disk on A directly to destination C. One move completes the task.
title: Tower of Hanoi with one disk (f(1))
